lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters is arranged in a multi-tiered horizontal grid posterior to the gill slits. The primary mid-lateral row contains at least five prominent, regularly spaced nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges. The most intense circular blobs are positioned precisely at these geometric intersections, forming a coordinate-like pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal carinae are visible along the dorsal-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift where the upper edge reflects light and the lower edge creates a linear shadow boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, medium-luminance spots primarily located on the anterior half of the fin blade, bounded by its dark silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An oversized, irregular high-luminance mark is present on the upper lateral flank, distinct from the uniform circular spots due to its larger pixel area and amorphous edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the lower flank near the right pectoral fin, visible as a dark elongated feature with a characteristic cephalic disc structure.
